_comment: The T-0 gate of the cflib example: what must hold seconds before the drone arms.
The two drone checks are this project's own (experiments/common/preflight/checks/). They
open the Crazyradio, so they run one at a time, and they need no middleware.

checklist.text: [HARD] No operator stop in the last 120 s.
[HARD] The battery is charged, read over the radio.
checklist.speak: The drone battery is low or unreadable.

checklist.text: [HARD] The Flow deck is detected and sees the floor.
checklist.speak: The flow deck does not see the floor.

checklist.text: [HARD] The recording directory is writable on the machine that records.

checklist: Operator: the drone stands on its mark on a flat, textured floor, nobody within 1.5 m, and you can reach it.
Operator: a second terminal is open in this project with the landing command typed: trials tool estop.sh --soft (without --soft it cuts the motors)
